description: Synthetic public receipt binding a verification-policy-lockfile digest to independent publication channels. v851 verifier checks may require valid_from/valid_until and channel published_at/observed_at temporal coherence with caller-supplied verifier time. It is a local verifier fixture, not proof of real election-office authority, trusted timestamping, or live publication governance.

packet_public_fingerprint_profile.description: Optional packet public fingerprint helper/report profile copied from the policy lockfile so the receipt binds both digest and digest-construction profile.

packet_public_fingerprint_sha256.description: Optional packet public fingerprint digest copied from the policy lockfile so the receipt binds the policy to the same selected packet public bytes.

locator_ref.description: Optional redacted/synthetic channel locator reference. Avoid embedding raw live URLs in publishable fixtures.

title: VerificationPolicyLockfilePublicationReceipt
